# ScanlyFix - Full Documentation

## Getting Started
To scan a website, go to scanlyfix.com and paste any URL.

## Features
- Security: Headers, CORS, CSP, exposed secrets
- SEO: Meta tags, robots.txt, sitemap, structured data
- AEO: AI visibility, content structure, citations
- Monitoring: Uptime checks with email alerts

## Products
### Security Scanner
Checks for:
- Security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)
- Exposed secrets and API keys
- CORS and CSRF protection
- SSL/TLS certificate status
- Directory listing and sensitive paths

### SEO Scanner
Checks for:
- Meta title and description
- Structured data (Schema.org)
- Sitemap and robots.txt
- Open Graph and Twitter cards
- Canonical tags and hreflang
- Core Web Vitals

### AEO Scanner
Checks for:
- AI bot access (llms.txt)
- Structured content
- FAQ and HowTo schema
- Citations and outbound links
- Server-side rendering

## API
The REST API provides access to all scan results.

### Authentication
Include your API key in the Authorization header.

## MCP Server
Use the MCP server to run scans from AI agents:

```bash
npx @scanlyfix/mcp-server
```

## Integrations
- GitHub App for repository scanning
- Supabase for backend security checks
